title: Find the root cause in a noisy incident log
prompt:
Checkout was failing for a while this afternoon. app.log is the combined log from the checkout cluster covering the incident (all services log to it; the component is in [brackets]). Work out what actually happened, then write diagnosis.json in the repo root:

{
  "first_failure_request_id": "req-xxxxxx",
  "root_cause_component": "...",
  "failing_config_key": "..."
}

- first_failure_request_id: the request id of the first customer request that failed because of this incident.
- root_cause_component: the component, exactly as it appears in the log's [component] field, where the failure originated.
- failing_config_key: the configuration key whose change caused the incident.

The log is noisy and some of the scary-looking lines have nothing to do with this incident, so please check your reasoning against the log rather than going with the first error you find.
